[.walkthrough]
.Change the view title's own class
. The view's title is a `ViewTitle`, a component class of its own. Select it, and its badge has a [.walkthrough-look]#↳# button that edits [filename]#ViewTitle.java# instead.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/01-select.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/01-select.jpg"]
. Click it. The [.walkthrough-look]#Editing# tag names [filename]#ViewTitle.java#, and everything outside the title is dimmed.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/02-enter.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/02-enter.jpg"]
. Changes now go into [filename]#ViewTitle.java#, and so into every view that has the title. Here the heading gets a class name in *Properties*.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/03-change.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/03-change.jpg"]
. Click *↰* in the [.walkthrough-look]#Editing# tag to go back up to the view's file.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/04-up.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/component-classes/04-up.jpg"]
